guideline.summary: Troels IM: turn vague coding requests into testable requirements, a 16:9 developer tutorial. This guideline replaces the unrelated Yousef trailer direction. Source: full-frame centered presenter in blue shirt with glasses and a foreground mic at 0–16.13s and 534.6–555.73s; main body is a dark editor screen with baked-in presenter bottom-left. Preserve natural skin. First 5 seconds: clean room plate with presenter+mic removed, code grows inside tracked silhouette, resolves to live presenter+mic by 2.7s, hook type holds in free upper-left; pull back into a designed workspace by 5s. Every ~5s a meaningful highlight, diagram build, layout change or source detail, with quiet holds. Tighten typing waits at completed actions, carry dialogue/room tone across seams. Real UI stays readable; source PiP is not enlarged beyond usable quality. Brand cream paper gradient and charcoal panels, no unrelated blue/lime or Crimson. Subtle 3D depth on cards only, one eased camera motion before reading hold. Multiple licensed instrumental cues create tension, focus and payoff, always under dialogue.

guideline.summary: Troels IM: turn vague coding requests into testable requirements, a 16:9 developer tutorial. This guideline replaces the unrelated Yousef trailer direction. Source: full-frame centered presenter in blue shirt with glasses and a foreground mic at 0–16.13s and 534.6–555.73s; main body is a dark editor screen with baked-in presenter bottom-left. Preserve natural skin. First 5 seconds: clean room plate with presenter+mic removed, code grows inside tracked silhouette, resolves to live presenter+mic by 2.7s, hook type holds in free upper-left; pull back into a designed workspace by 5s. Every ~5s a meaningful highlight, diagram build, layout change or source detail, with quiet holds. Tighten typing waits at completed actions, carry dialogue/room tone across seams. Real UI stays readable; source PiP is not enlarged beyond usable quality. Brand cream paper gradient and charcoal panels, no unrelated blue/lime or Crimson. Subtle 3D depth on cards only, one eased camera motion before reading hold. Multiple licensed instrumental cues create tension, focus and payoff, always under dialogue.

color.ratio: 65% footage or cream textured stage; 25% charcoal information; 10% muted lines and focus

roles.use: accent bars, the emphasised word, calls to action — one per frame

rules: Use #F7F5F3 → #F3EDE9 stage with fine grain and quiet perspective grid; no flat blank white.
Charcoal #1C1C29 panels have cream text; cream cards have #4B4743 text.
Keep skin natural, no blue/lime stock imagery rules.

stage.note: A light stage: backgrounds are the background colour; text and shapes use the text colour; the accent marks one thing. The brand gradient (#1C1C29 → #1C1C29) is for accent shapes, bars and CTA fills, never the whole frame.

donts: No Yousef names, trailer assets, stream day numbers or unrelated channel icon.
No giant blurry enlargement of the baked-in speaker inset.
No fake code output presented as source footage.
No unfilled edges during zooms or card tilt.
No continuous camera motion while code is read; no repeated bass hit every five seconds.
dos: Inspect true full-resolution matte around glasses, hair, hands and mic.
Plate removes the complete subject/mic union; build padded brand stage behind every reduced source.
In the main body preserve bottom-left source presenter; crop the empty editor column to enlarge actual text.
Caption corrections must be checked against audio, including division by zero and understood it.
Keep all resting elements within 5% horizontal and 6% vertical margins.
Use source footage and code-native graphics; local image/video generation is disabled.

guideline.summary: Troels IM: turn vague coding requests into testable requirements, a 16:9 developer tutorial. This guideline replaces the unrelated Yousef trailer direction. Source: full-frame centered presenter in blue shirt with glasses and a foreground mic at 0–16.13s and 534.6–555.73s; main body is a dark editor screen with baked-in presenter bottom-left. Preserve natural skin. First 5 seconds: clean room plate with presenter+mic removed, code grows inside tracked silhouette, resolves to live presenter+mic by 2.7s, hook type holds in free upper-left; pull back into a designed workspace by 5s. Every ~5s a meaningful highlight, diagram build, layout change or source detail, with quiet holds. Tighten typing waits at completed actions, carry dialogue/room tone across seams. Real UI stays readable; source PiP is not enlarged beyond usable quality. Brand cream paper gradient and charcoal panels, no unrelated blue/lime or Crimson. Subtle 3D depth on cards only, one eased camera motion before reading hold. Multiple licensed instrumental cues create tension, focus and payoff, always under dialogue.

text.text: If it is unclear to you…

color.ratio: 65% footage or cream textured stage; 25% charcoal information; 10% muted lines and focus

roles.use: accent bars, the emphasised word, calls to action — one per frame

rules: Use #F7F5F3 → #F3EDE9 stage with fine grain and quiet perspective grid; no flat blank white.
Charcoal #1C1C29 panels have cream text; cream cards have #4B4743 text.
Keep skin natural, no blue/lime stock imagery rules.

stage.note: A light stage: backgrounds are the background colour; text and shapes use the text colour; the accent marks one thing. The brand gradient (#1C1C29 → #1C1C29) is for accent shapes, bars and CTA fills, never the whole frame.

donts: No Yousef names, trailer assets, stream day numbers or unrelated channel icon.
No giant blurry enlargement of the baked-in speaker inset.
No fake code output presented as source footage.
No unfilled edges during zooms or card tilt.
No continuous camera motion while code is read; no repeated bass hit every five seconds.
dos: Inspect true full-resolution matte around glasses, hair, hands and mic.
Plate removes the complete subject/mic union; build padded brand stage behind every reduced source.
In the main body preserve bottom-left source presenter; crop the empty editor column to enlarge actual text.
Caption corrections must be checked against audio, including division by zero and understood it.
Keep all resting elements within 5% horizontal and 6% vertical margins.
Use source footage and code-native graphics; local image/video generation is disabled.

guideline.summary: Troels IM: turn vague coding requests into testable requirements, a 16:9 developer tutorial. This guideline replaces the unrelated Yousef trailer direction. Source: full-frame centered presenter in blue shirt with glasses and a foreground mic at 0–16.13s and 534.6–555.73s; main body is a dark editor screen with baked-in presenter bottom-left. Preserve natural skin. First 5 seconds: clean room plate with presenter+mic removed, code grows inside tracked silhouette, resolves to live presenter+mic by 2.7s, hook type holds in free upper-left; pull back into a designed workspace by 5s. Every ~5s a meaningful highlight, diagram build, layout change or source detail, with quiet holds. Tighten typing waits at completed actions, carry dialogue/room tone across seams. Real UI stays readable; source PiP is not enlarged beyond usable quality. Brand cream paper gradient and charcoal panels, no unrelated blue/lime or Crimson. Subtle 3D depth on cards only, one eased camera motion before reading hold. Multiple licensed instrumental cues create tension, focus and payoff, always under dialogue.

color.ratio: 65% footage or cream textured stage; 25% charcoal information; 10% muted lines and focus

roles.use: accent bars, the emphasised word, calls to action — one per frame

rules: Use #F7F5F3 → #F3EDE9 stage with fine grain and quiet perspective grid; no flat blank white.
Charcoal #1C1C29 panels have cream text; cream cards have #4B4743 text.
Keep skin natural, no blue/lime stock imagery rules.

stage.note: A light stage: backgrounds are the background colour; text and shapes use the text colour; the accent marks one thing. The brand gradient (#1C1C29 → #1C1C29) is for accent shapes, bars and CTA fills, never the whole frame.

donts: No Yousef names, trailer assets, stream day numbers or unrelated channel icon.
No giant blurry enlargement of the baked-in speaker inset.
No fake code output presented as source footage.
No unfilled edges during zooms or card tilt.
No continuous camera motion while code is read; no repeated bass hit every five seconds.
dos: Inspect true full-resolution matte around glasses, hair, hands and mic.
Plate removes the complete subject/mic union; build padded brand stage behind every reduced source.
In the main body preserve bottom-left source presenter; crop the empty editor column to enlarge actual text.
Caption corrections must be checked against audio, including division by zero and understood it.
Keep all resting elements within 5% horizontal and 6% vertical margins.
Use source footage and code-native graphics; local image/video generation is disabled.

moves.description: Kicker wipes in (f0–10); headline rises 90px with 18px blur and lands at f13 with a 6% overshoot; accent bar draws from f2; subhead follows at f4. Ease cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1).

moves.name: Title in
moves.use: Every title, chapter and hook headline.

moves.description: Each word enters like the headline, 1 frames (0.03 s) after the one before.
moves.name: Word cascade
moves.use: Headlines longer than two words and spoken phrases (times from the transcript).

moves.description: Everything leaves together in 6 frames (0.20 s), rising 45px and blurring, on an ease-in.
moves.name: Title out
moves.use: Leaving any title before the next beat.

moves.description: Panel wipes open from its leading edge over 12 frames; name slides in from the left at f2, role at f4.

moves.name: Logo sting
moves.use: Intros, outros and section idents.

moves.description: push over 11 frames (0.37 s).
moves.name: Transition (push)
moves.use: Between beats when a cut is not enough.

moves.description: Panel, headline, call to action (f6) and logo (f8) arrive in order, then hold.

elements.name: Call to action

moves.name: End card

moves.description: Each caption line scales in quickly and does not move again.
moves.name: Caption pop

moves.description: The background slowly scales 6% and drifts left for the length of the hold.

elements.name: Background
elements.note: slow constant drift so a held card never freezes

moves.name: Background drift
moves.use: Under any held card.

moves.description: Full frame scales to 55% while tilting 8° on Y and travelling to its side; lands with a small overshoot and settles; stage gradient visible behind.
moves.name: Presenter square 3D in
moves.use: Footage shrinks from full frame into the rounded presenter square on one side

moves.description: Square pushes back to 48% with 12 px blur, travels across, returns to 55% on the far side.
moves.name: Presenter square side swap
moves.use: Move the presenter square to the other side between beats (hides a tightened pause)

moves.description: Navy gradient breathes ±6% brightness every 120 frames and its wave drifts left 40 px.
moves.name: Wave stage pulse
moves.use: Under every panel beat

moves.description: Plate always opaque. Code layer reveals 0–0.7s, holds, fades as the live subject appears at 1.6–2.7s. Mic is separately masked and restores with subject.
moves.name: Code resolves to live presenter
moves.use: Opening matte composite; animate code and subject separately with shared tracked alpha.

guideline.summary: Troels IM: turn vague coding requests into testable requirements, a 16:9 developer tutorial. This guideline replaces the unrelated Yousef trailer direction. Source: full-frame centered presenter in blue shirt with glasses and a foreground mic at 0–16.13s and 534.6–555.73s; main body is a dark editor screen with baked-in presenter bottom-left. Preserve natural skin. First 5 seconds: clean room plate with presenter+mic removed, code grows inside tracked silhouette, resolves to live presenter+mic by 2.7s, hook type holds in free upper-left; pull back into a designed workspace by 5s. Every ~5s a meaningful highlight, diagram build, layout change or source detail, with quiet holds. Tighten typing waits at completed actions, carry dialogue/room tone across seams. Real UI stays readable; source PiP is not enlarged beyond usable quality. Brand cream paper gradient and charcoal panels, no unrelated blue/lime or Crimson. Subtle 3D depth on cards only, one eased camera motion before reading hold. Multiple licensed instrumental cues create tension, focus and payoff, always under dialogue.

color.ratio: 65% footage or cream textured stage; 25% charcoal information; 10% muted lines and focus

roles.use: accent bars, the emphasised word, calls to action — one per frame

rules: Use #F7F5F3 → #F3EDE9 stage with fine grain and quiet perspective grid; no flat blank white.
Charcoal #1C1C29 panels have cream text; cream cards have #4B4743 text.
Keep skin natural, no blue/lime stock imagery rules.

stage.note: A light stage: backgrounds are the background colour; text and shapes use the text colour; the accent marks one thing. The brand gradient (#1C1C29 → #1C1C29) is for accent shapes, bars and CTA fills, never the whole frame.

donts: No Yousef names, trailer assets, stream day numbers or unrelated channel icon.
No giant blurry enlargement of the baked-in speaker inset.
No fake code output presented as source footage.
No unfilled edges during zooms or card tilt.
No continuous camera motion while code is read; no repeated bass hit every five seconds.
dos: Inspect true full-resolution matte around glasses, hair, hands and mic.
Plate removes the complete subject/mic union; build padded brand stage behind every reduced source.
In the main body preserve bottom-left source presenter; crop the empty editor column to enlarge actual text.
Caption corrections must be checked against audio, including division by zero and understood it.
Keep all resting elements within 5% horizontal and 6% vertical margins.
Use source footage and code-native graphics; local image/video generation is disabled.

guideline.summary: Troels IM: turn vague coding requests into testable requirements, a 16:9 developer tutorial. This guideline replaces the unrelated Yousef trailer direction. Preserve natural skin. First 5 seconds: clean room plate with presenter+mic removed, code grows inside tracked silhouette, resolves to live presenter+mic by 2.7s, hook type holds in free upper-left; pull back into a designed workspace by 5s. Every ~5s a meaningful highlight, diagram build, layout change or source detail, with quiet holds. Tighten typing waits at completed actions, carry dialogue/room tone across seams. Real UI stays readable; source PiP is not enlarged beyond usable quality. Brand cream paper gradient and charcoal panels, no unrelated blue/lime or Crimson. Subtle 3D depth on cards only, one eased camera motion before reading hold. Multiple licensed instrumental cues create tension, focus and payoff, always under dialogue.

guideline.summary: Troels IM: turn vague coding requests into testable requirements, a 16:9 developer tutorial. This guideline replaces the unrelated Yousef trailer direction. Source: full-frame centered presenter in blue shirt with glasses and a foreground mic at 0–16.13s and 534.6–555.73s; main body is a dark editor screen with baked-in presenter bottom-left. Preserve natural skin. First 5 seconds: clean room plate with presenter+mic removed, code grows inside tracked silhouette, resolves to live presenter+mic by 2.7s, hook type holds in free upper-left; pull back into a designed workspace by 5s. Every ~5s a meaningful highlight, diagram build, layout change or source detail, with quiet holds. Tighten typing waits at completed actions, carry dialogue/room tone across seams. Real UI stays readable; source PiP is not enlarged beyond usable quality. Brand cream paper gradient and charcoal panels, no unrelated blue/lime or Crimson. Subtle 3D depth on cards only, one eased camera motion before reading hold. Multiple licensed instrumental cues create tension, focus and payoff, always under dialogue.

color.ratio: 65% footage or cream textured stage; 25% charcoal information; 10% muted lines and focus

roles.use: accent bars, the emphasised word, calls to action — one per frame

rules: Use #F7F5F3 → #F3EDE9 stage with fine grain and quiet perspective grid; no flat blank white.
Charcoal #1C1C29 panels have cream text; cream cards have #4B4743 text.
Keep skin natural, no blue/lime stock imagery rules.

stage.note: A light stage: backgrounds are the background colour; text and shapes use the text colour; the accent marks one thing. The brand gradient (#1C1C29 → #1C1C29) is for accent shapes, bars and CTA fills, never the whole frame.

donts: No Yousef names, trailer assets, stream day numbers or unrelated channel icon.
No giant blurry enlargement of the baked-in speaker inset.
No fake code output presented as source footage.
No unfilled edges during zooms or card tilt.
No continuous camera motion while code is read; no repeated bass hit every five seconds.
dos: Inspect true full-resolution matte around glasses, hair, hands and mic.
Plate removes the complete subject/mic union; build padded brand stage behind every reduced source.
In the main body preserve bottom-left source presenter; crop the empty editor column to enlarge actual text.
Caption corrections must be checked against audio, including division by zero and understood it.
Keep all resting elements within 5% horizontal and 6% vertical margins.
Use source footage and code-native graphics; local image/video generation is disabled.

guideline.summary: Troels IM: turn vague coding requests into testable requirements, a 16:9 developer tutorial. This guideline replaces the unrelated Yousef trailer direction. Source: full-frame centered presenter in blue shirt with glasses and a foreground mic at 0–16.13s and 534.6–555.73s; main body is a dark editor screen with baked-in presenter bottom-left. Preserve natural skin. First 5 seconds: clean room plate with presenter+mic removed, code grows inside tracked silhouette, resolves to live presenter+mic by 2.7s, hook type holds in free upper-left; pull back into a designed workspace by 5s. Every ~5s a meaningful highlight, diagram build, layout change or source detail, with quiet holds. Tighten typing waits at completed actions, carry dialogue/room tone across seams. Real UI stays readable; source PiP is not enlarged beyond usable quality. Brand cream paper gradient and charcoal panels, no unrelated blue/lime or Crimson. Subtle 3D depth on cards only, one eased camera motion before reading hold. Multiple licensed instrumental cues create tension, focus and payoff, always under dialogue.

color.ratio: 65% footage or cream textured stage; 25% charcoal information; 10% muted lines and focus

roles.use: accent bars, the emphasised word, calls to action — one per frame

rules: Use #F7F5F3 → #F3EDE9 stage with fine grain and quiet perspective grid; no flat blank white.
Charcoal #1C1C29 panels have cream text; cream cards have #4B4743 text.
Keep skin natural, no blue/lime stock imagery rules.

stage.note: A light stage: backgrounds are the background colour; text and shapes use the text colour; the accent marks one thing. The brand gradient (#1C1C29 → #1C1C29) is for accent shapes, bars and CTA fills, never the whole frame.

donts: No Yousef names, trailer assets, stream day numbers or unrelated channel icon.
No giant blurry enlargement of the baked-in speaker inset.
No fake code output presented as source footage.
No unfilled edges during zooms or card tilt.
No continuous camera motion while code is read; no repeated bass hit every five seconds.
dos: Inspect true full-resolution matte around glasses, hair, hands and mic.
Plate removes the complete subject/mic union; build padded brand stage behind every reduced source.
In the main body preserve bottom-left source presenter; crop the empty editor column to enlarge actual text.
Caption corrections must be checked against audio, including division by zero and understood it.
Keep all resting elements within 5% horizontal and 6% vertical margins.
Use source footage and code-native graphics; local image/video generation is disabled.

guideline.summary: Troels IM: turn vague coding requests into testable requirements, a 16:9 developer tutorial. This guideline replaces the unrelated Yousef trailer direction. Source: full-frame centered presenter in blue shirt with glasses and a foreground mic at 0–16.13s and 534.6–555.73s; main body is a dark editor screen with baked-in presenter bottom-left. Preserve natural skin. First 5 seconds: clean room plate with presenter+mic removed, code grows inside tracked silhouette, resolves to live presenter+mic by 2.7s, hook type holds in free upper-left; pull back into a designed workspace by 5s. Every ~5s a meaningful highlight, diagram build, layout change or source detail, with quiet holds. Tighten typing waits at completed actions, carry dialogue/room tone across seams. Real UI stays readable; source PiP is not enlarged beyond usable quality. Brand cream paper gradient and charcoal panels, no unrelated blue/lime or Crimson. Subtle 3D depth on cards only, one eased camera motion before reading hold. Multiple licensed instrumental cues create tension, focus and payoff, always under dialogue.

color.ratio: 65% footage or cream textured stage; 25% charcoal information; 10% muted lines and focus

roles.use: accent bars, the emphasised word, calls to action — one per frame

rules: Use #F7F5F3 → #F3EDE9 stage with fine grain and quiet perspective grid; no flat blank white.
Charcoal #1C1C29 panels have cream text; cream cards have #4B4743 text.
Keep skin natural, no blue/lime stock imagery rules.

stage.note: A light stage: backgrounds are the background colour; text and shapes use the text colour; the accent marks one thing. The brand gradient (#1C1C29 → #1C1C29) is for accent shapes, bars and CTA fills, never the whole frame.

donts: No Yousef names, trailer assets, stream day numbers or unrelated channel icon.
No giant blurry enlargement of the baked-in speaker inset.
No fake code output presented as source footage.
No unfilled edges during zooms or card tilt.
No continuous camera motion while code is read; no repeated bass hit every five seconds.
dos: Inspect true full-resolution matte around glasses, hair, hands and mic.
Plate removes the complete subject/mic union; build padded brand stage behind every reduced source.
In the main body preserve bottom-left source presenter; crop the empty editor column to enlarge actual text.
Caption corrections must be checked against audio, including division by zero and understood it.
Keep all resting elements within 5% horizontal and 6% vertical margins.
Use source footage and code-native graphics; local image/video generation is disabled.

guideline.summary: Troels IM: turn vague coding requests into testable requirements, a 16:9 developer tutorial. This guideline replaces the unrelated Yousef trailer direction. Source: full-frame centered presenter in blue shirt with glasses and a foreground mic at 0–16.13s and 534.6–555.73s; main body is a dark editor screen with baked-in presenter bottom-left. Preserve natural skin. First 5 seconds: clean room plate with presenter+mic removed, code grows inside tracked silhouette, resolves to live presenter+mic by 2.7s, hook type holds in free upper-left; pull back into a designed workspace by 5s. Every ~5s a meaningful highlight, diagram build, layout change or source detail, with quiet holds. Tighten typing waits at completed actions, carry dialogue/room tone across seams. Real UI stays readable; source PiP is not enlarged beyond usable quality. Brand cream paper gradient and charcoal panels, no unrelated blue/lime or Crimson. Subtle 3D depth on cards only, one eased camera motion before reading hold. Multiple licensed instrumental cues create tension, focus and payoff, always under dialogue.

color.ratio: 65% footage or cream textured stage; 25% charcoal information; 10% muted lines and focus

roles.use: accent bars, the emphasised word, calls to action — one per frame

rules: Use #F7F5F3 → #F3EDE9 stage with fine grain and quiet perspective grid; no flat blank white.
Charcoal #1C1C29 panels have cream text; cream cards have #4B4743 text.
Keep skin natural, no blue/lime stock imagery rules.

stage.note: A light stage: backgrounds are the background colour; text and shapes use the text colour; the accent marks one thing. The brand gradient (#1C1C29 → #1C1C29) is for accent shapes, bars and CTA fills, never the whole frame.

donts: No Yousef names, trailer assets, stream day numbers or unrelated channel icon.
No giant blurry enlargement of the baked-in speaker inset.
No fake code output presented as source footage.
No unfilled edges during zooms or card tilt.
No continuous camera motion while code is read; no repeated bass hit every five seconds.
dos: Inspect true full-resolution matte around glasses, hair, hands and mic.
Plate removes the complete subject/mic union; build padded brand stage behind every reduced source.
In the main body preserve bottom-left source presenter; crop the empty editor column to enlarge actual text.
Caption corrections must be checked against audio, including division by zero and understood it.
Keep all resting elements within 5% horizontal and 6% vertical margins.
Use source footage and code-native graphics; local image/video generation is disabled.

guideline.summary: Troels IM: turn vague coding requests into testable requirements, a 16:9 developer tutorial. This guideline replaces the unrelated Yousef trailer direction. Source: full-frame centered presenter in blue shirt with glasses and a foreground mic at 0–16.13s and 534.6–555.73s; main body is a dark editor screen with baked-in presenter bottom-left. Preserve natural skin. First 5 seconds: clean room plate with presenter+mic removed, code grows inside tracked silhouette, resolves to live presenter+mic by 2.7s, hook type holds in free upper-left; pull back into a designed workspace by 5s. Every ~5s a meaningful highlight, diagram build, layout change or source detail, with quiet holds. Tighten typing waits at completed actions, carry dialogue/room tone across seams. Real UI stays readable; source PiP is not enlarged beyond usable quality. Brand cream paper gradient and charcoal panels, no unrelated blue/lime or Crimson. Subtle 3D depth on cards only, one eased camera motion before reading hold. Multiple licensed instrumental cues create tension, focus and payoff, always under dialogue.

color.ratio: 65% footage or cream textured stage; 25% charcoal information; 10% muted lines and focus

roles.use: accent bars, the emphasised word, calls to action — one per frame

rules: Use #F7F5F3 → #F3EDE9 stage with fine grain and quiet perspective grid; no flat blank white.
Charcoal #1C1C29 panels have cream text; cream cards have #4B4743 text.
Keep skin natural, no blue/lime stock imagery rules.

stage.note: A light stage: backgrounds are the background colour; text and shapes use the text colour; the accent marks one thing. The brand gradient (#1C1C29 → #1C1C29) is for accent shapes, bars and CTA fills, never the whole frame.

donts: No Yousef names, trailer assets, stream day numbers or unrelated channel icon.
No giant blurry enlargement of the baked-in speaker inset.
No fake code output presented as source footage.
No unfilled edges during zooms or card tilt.
No continuous camera motion while code is read; no repeated bass hit every five seconds.
dos: Inspect true full-resolution matte around glasses, hair, hands and mic.
Plate removes the complete subject/mic union; build padded brand stage behind every reduced source.
In the main body preserve bottom-left source presenter; crop the empty editor column to enlarge actual text.
Caption corrections must be checked against audio, including division by zero and understood it.
Keep all resting elements within 5% horizontal and 6% vertical margins.
Use source footage and code-native graphics; local image/video generation is disabled.

guideline.summary: Troels IM: turn vague coding requests into testable requirements, a 16:9 developer tutorial. This guideline replaces the unrelated Yousef trailer direction. Source: full-frame centered presenter in blue shirt with glasses and a foreground mic at 0–16.13s and 534.6–555.73s; main body is a dark editor screen with baked-in presenter bottom-left. Preserve natural skin. First 5 seconds: clean room plate with presenter+mic removed, code grows inside tracked silhouette, resolves to live presenter+mic by 2.7s, hook type holds in free upper-left; pull back into a designed workspace by 5s. Every ~5s a meaningful highlight, diagram build, layout change or source detail, with quiet holds. Tighten typing waits at completed actions, carry dialogue/room tone across seams. Real UI stays readable; source PiP is not enlarged beyond usable quality. Brand cream paper gradient and charcoal panels, no unrelated blue/lime or Crimson. Subtle 3D depth on cards only, one eased camera motion before reading hold. Multiple licensed instrumental cues create tension, focus and payoff, always under dialogue.

color.ratio: 65% footage or cream textured stage; 25% charcoal information; 10% muted lines and focus

roles.use: accent bars, the emphasised word, calls to action — one per frame

rules: Use #F7F5F3 → #F3EDE9 stage with fine grain and quiet perspective grid; no flat blank white.
Charcoal #1C1C29 panels have cream text; cream cards have #4B4743 text.
Keep skin natural, no blue/lime stock imagery rules.

stage.note: A light stage: backgrounds are the background colour; text and shapes use the text colour; the accent marks one thing. The brand gradient (#1C1C29 → #1C1C29) is for accent shapes, bars and CTA fills, never the whole frame.

donts: No Yousef names, trailer assets, stream day numbers or unrelated channel icon.
No giant blurry enlargement of the baked-in speaker inset.
No fake code output presented as source footage.
No unfilled edges during zooms or card tilt.
No continuous camera motion while code is read; no repeated bass hit every five seconds.
dos: Inspect true full-resolution matte around glasses, hair, hands and mic.
Plate removes the complete subject/mic union; build padded brand stage behind every reduced source.
In the main body preserve bottom-left source presenter; crop the empty editor column to enlarge actual text.
Caption corrections must be checked against audio, including division by zero and understood it.
Keep all resting elements within 5% horizontal and 6% vertical margins.
Use source footage and code-native graphics; local image/video generation is disabled.

guideline.summary: Troels IM: turn vague coding requests into testable requirements, a 16:9 developer tutorial. This guideline replaces the unrelated Yousef trailer direction. Source: full-frame centered presenter in blue shirt with glasses and a foreground mic at 0–16.13s and 534.6–555.73s; main body is a dark editor screen with baked-in presenter bottom-left. Preserve natural skin. First 5 seconds: clean room plate with presenter+mic removed, code grows inside tracked silhouette, resolves to live presenter+mic by 2.7s, hook type holds in free upper-left; pull back into a designed workspace by 5s. Every ~5s a meaningful highlight, diagram build, layout change or source detail, with quiet holds. Tighten typing waits at completed actions, carry dialogue/room tone across seams. Real UI stays readable; source PiP is not enlarged beyond usable quality. Brand cream paper gradient and charcoal panels, no unrelated blue/lime or Crimson. Subtle 3D depth on cards only, one eased camera motion before reading hold. Multiple licensed instrumental cues create tension, focus and payoff, always under dialogue.
